speaker: richard_field
text: And keep us this day from a grace we have not earned. Amen.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Amen. Sit. The hen has waited longer than the prayer.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I came over Paul's with the comedy under my cloak. All of it. The book-keeper will live without it a few nights.

speaker: richard_field
text: Thou didst not need a procession. Sit. I carve short. The grace was the long part. A hen in a French pot is still a hen.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: The apprentices are at their catechism under the floor. Do not teach them a play by shouting.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will keep my voice for the table. I can spare the book until Tuesday. Thursday is a part, and it is not this comedy.

speaker: richard_field
text: Before Tuesday, then. I am not keeping a player's book into a playing week. Eat.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: The carving is short, which is a mercy after that grace. Pass nothing yet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Richard. The Lives. A great book coming off again, thou saidst.

speaker: richard_field
text: Plutarch, in sheets. Come and see it hang. Wet ink flatters everybody. Dry, it is only what the letters say.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will come when it hangs. I am not naming a day, and I am not buying it off a stall to save the walk.

speaker: richard_field
text: Good. Do not buy it. The walk is the point of a sheet. I asked thee to come, not to pay me at table.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: He has a question he means to let go. Let him ask it before the cheese.

speaker: richard_field
text: The chronicle. Does the cat still read the second volume.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The cat has the stair. The chronicle is on my board. I am not walking Paul's with two books.

speaker: richard_field
text: Then it stays. I asked. I am letting it go. Today I want the comedy, and the hen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Last night the share was four-and-thirty. I am not bringing a purse to a Sunday table.

speaker: richard_field
text: I did not ask for a purse. I asked for a book. Eat, before the cheese is promoted.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Thy brother is fifteen. The letter sits, or it has gone. I am not thy carrier.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It sits. It goes by the carrier of the fifteenth. He is fifteen as of yesterday. I told him to finish school, and I enclosed nothing.

speaker: richard_field
text: A brother at fifteen should be at his grammar. Thou saidst as much, I hope, and not a speech about the tiring-house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I said Latin is the only property a player never has to hire. That is the letter.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Then enclose nothing at my table either. The bread on the right. The other loaf is tomorrow's.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The right-hand loaf. I hear thee, Richard. The close does not pull that out of my mouth. This room does.

speaker: richard_field
text: The close is London. This room is not. The long part was the grace. The short part is the meat. Eat it.
